purpose: Define validated instance-configuration reload that reconciles instance-owned configuration and referenced subsystem bindings without replacing unrelated semantic data.

topics.name: Instance Configuration Reload
topics.purpose: Define validated instance-configuration reload that reconciles instance-owned configuration and referenced subsystem bindings without replacing unrelated semantic data.

semantics.target_rule: Reload targets an exact AIGMos instance identity.
semantics.candidate_rule: Candidate instance config is parsed/validated before affecting runtime.
semantics.owner_rule: Reload applies instance-owned fields and invokes referenced owner-specific reconciliation where required.
semantics.iam_rule: IAM parent changes route through explicit IAM binding semantics.
semantics.ac_rule: AccessCore activation/reload follows explicit AC lifecycle semantics; when AC is active it cannot be disabled through an unauthorized runtime mutation.
semantics.listener_rule: Listener binding changes use listener lifecycle/conflict validation.
semantics.module_rule: UserModule changes use UserModule lifecycle/reload semantics.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed reconciliation leaves a deterministic previous or safe stopped state.
semantics.trace_rule: Reload records old/new config refs, subsystem actions and result.

invariants.rule: AIGMos instance identity, configuration, IAM parent, AccessCore parent and runtime state remain explicit separate dimensions; configuration never silently changes semantic ownership or authority.

hard_gates.condition: listener binding changed without conflict validation
failed reload leaves mixed ambiguous config
reload disables active AC without governed operation

references.purpose: Instance config reload participates in runtime reload.
